answer: Funding-graph quorums turn a glacier of fake keys into one vote. Keys are clustered by their first funding source in a public ledge, and a 9-seat committee draws at most 1 key per cluster. Each key bonds 50 POA, so an ocean of fakes funded from one wallet fills a single seat. To hold 5 of 9 seats an attacker needs 5 separately funded clusters. Attacker pays 250 POA in bonds this epoch (5 x 50), slashed if caught.
